places.name: Svalbard and Jan Mayen
notes: Country-level ISO 3166-1 seed for Svalbard and Jan Mayen; public place metadata only.
This pack records the two ISO/GeoNames components plus their administrative-centre cross-references.
Svalbard and Jan Mayen are not treated as a single local administrative system; component packs carry operational detail.

places.name: Svalbard
notes: Complete SJ first-order seed; first-order type: first-order territory / archipelago component.
GeoNames/Svalbard-Jan Mayen references administrative division list: GeoNames ADM1 component rows include Svalbard.
GeoNames subdivision listing row: Svalbard, ADM1 row with Longyearbyen as capital.
Boundary geometry is linked for review and not bundled in this seed pack.
Separate Svalbard pack records planning areas; this combined pack only links the ISO SJ component.

places.name: Jan Mayen
notes: Complete SJ first-order seed; first-order type: first-order island component.
GeoNames/Svalbard-Jan Mayen references administrative division list: GeoNames ADM1 component rows include Jan Mayen.
GeoNames subdivision listing row: Jan Mayen, ADM1 row with Olonkinbyen as capital.
Boundary geometry is linked for review and not bundled in this seed pack.
Separate Jan Mayen pack records station and natural-reference seeds; no permanent address layer is claimed.

places.name: Longyearbyen
notes: Complete SJ first-order seed; first-order type: administrative centre / capital settlement.
GeoNames/Svalbard-Jan Mayen references administrative division list: GeoNames country metadata and ADM1 rows list Longyearbyen as the SJ/Svalbard capital.
GeoNames subdivision listing row: Longyearbyen, largest city and administrative centre cross-reference.
Boundary geometry is linked for review and not bundled in this seed pack.
GeoNames country metadata lists Longyearbyen as capital.

places.name: Olonkinbyen
notes: Complete SJ first-order seed; first-order type: Jan Mayen station / administrative centre.
GeoNames/Svalbard-Jan Mayen references administrative division list: GeoNames ADM1 row lists Olonkinbyen as the Jan Mayen capital.
GeoNames subdivision listing row: Olonkinbyen, seat of Jan Mayen first-order division.
Boundary geometry is linked for review and not bundled in this seed pack.
Station seed only; no permanent-population or private-address claim is made.
